description: Independently authored expected baseline. Adjudicate additional valid defects instead of silently changing expectations to fit model output.

findings.notes: Flask has no version constraint or lock resolution. Inspect the actual requirement.
README and module docstring establish that this is production configuration.
An absolute developer Windows path cannot serve as portable deployment configuration.
The test step explicitly permits failure; the workflow can pass with failing tests.
python:latest changes over time and does not fix the declared Python version.
The declared production deployment launches Flask's development server.
